contracts.signal: AstraZeneca and Oracle Health and Life Sciences launched a global AI collaboration combining AstraZeneca's scientific, clinical development and regulatory expertise with Oracle's real-world data, cloud infrastructure and AI-enabled clinical capabilities; initial areas are clinical trial recruitment, earlier diagnosis, drug-safety monitoring and real-world evidence, across oncology, cardiovascular, renal and metabolic, respiratory and immunology, and rare disease. The first programme supports hypertension care and clinical research in Abu Dhabi with healthcare company M42. The companies signed a non-binding term-sheet agreement; no financials were disclosed.
